==Life Cycle==
[[File:Process Life Cycle.jpg|thumb]]

===New===
===Ready===
Ready processes are put into a queue for the processor to process. They then go to the running category

===Running===
===Waiting===
===Terminated===
==Scheduler==
Context switch determines what the CPU runs
Short term scheduler determines what goes into the CPU next
Long term scheduler deicides which jobs go into memory
==Types==
*  io bound processes spend most of their time waiting for io to be done
* cpu bound processes spend most of their time waiting for the cpu
